_howto: Guided setup for Access Control (Demo / Setup mode). Steps use 'click' (a menu link) because this page has its own menu.
title: Set up Access Control
intro: Work through these in order. You're in demo: nothing is sent to your controllers, and nothing affects live until you push it.

steps.title: Time zones
steps.why: Weekly timetables for when doors and levels may be used. 24 Hours is always there; add others such as office hours.

steps.title: Doors
steps.why: A door for each lock on each controller, with its direction, unlock time and exit rule.

steps.title: Access levels
steps.why: Sets of doors with a time zone, that you give to people.

steps.title: Who gets which level
steps.why: Give departments their levels (new starters included), and individual people any extras.

steps.title: Schedule rules
steps.why: For levels that only work when people are scheduled: how early before and how long after the shift, and whether leave blocks access.

steps.title: Zones
steps.why: Zones and which doors lead between them, so you can see who is inside, for example for a muster list.

steps.title: Test run
steps.why:
Prove it works, all in demo:
  1. Schedule Rules › Try it: pick a person and check when they could get in.
  2. Reports: check who can open which door.
Nothing is sent to the controllers from demo; after pushing, the controllers get the changes from live.
